test: cellulose CHARMM36 term-by-term energies: GROMACS vs OpenMM and LAMMPS

lammps_conventions_removed_before_compar.coulomb_constant: LAMMPS CHARMM 332.0716 vs GROMACS 332.0637 kcal A/mol/e^2; LAMMPS electrostatics scaled by 0.99997625
lammps_conventions_removed_before_compar.charmmfsw_one_four_lj_offset: constant per-pair energy offset of dihedral_style charmmfsw (10-12 angstrom), computed analytically and subtracted
lammps_conventions_removed_before_compar.short_range_lj_switch: CHARMM vfswitch (LAMMPS lj/charmmfsw) and GROMACS force-switch differ by a constant potential shift; the difference is evaluated over every non-excluded pair and subtracted

angle_split: GROMACS reports angle + Urey-Bradley as U-B; the split is evaluated from GROMACS's resolved parameters (gmx dump) and must sum to U-B
nonbonded_tolerance: relative to the summed magnitude of GROMACS nonbonded components
